transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling really down on myself. I keep thinking I’ve let my family down by taking on this mortgage, and every little mistake I make at work feels like proof that I’m useless… like I deserve whatever happens to me.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family and friends?

Yeah, I have. I used to joke around with the regulars at work, and after my shifts I’d usually text my brother back. Lately I just kind of keep a straight face, say what I need to say, and leave it at that. Messages sit there because I don’t really feel like answering, even when I know I should.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or waking up earlier than you should?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change with my sleep, at least not enough that I’ve been keeping track of it.
Have you been feeling like you’re a failure or that you’ve done something wrong, maybe even feeling guilty about things you wouldn’t usually feel guilty about?

Yes. That’s a big part of why I came in. I keep feeling like I let my family down by taking on this mortgage, and then at work, even a small mistake feels like proof that I’m useless. It’s like I deserve whatever happens after that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah. Most days I feel pretty down, like there’s this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I still go through the motions at work, carrying plates and smiling when I’m supposed to, but it doesn’t really feel real or good.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah, I think so. People at work have pointed it out. Some shifts I’m pacing around, checking the same tables or receipts over and over like I can’t settle. Other times I feel really slowed down, like even grabbing menus or walking over to the POS takes me longer than it should.
Have you noticed that you're losing energy easily or feeling fatigued, even if you haven't done anything physically or mentally demanding?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tired after work, but that seems normal with being on my feet. I haven’t noticed feeling wiped out for no reason, not in a way that really stands out.
Have you completely lost pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family and friends?

I don’t know if I’d say completely lost pleasure. I still do things sometimes, and there are moments they’re okay. It’s more that I don’t feel much from them lately, but I’m not sure it’s totally gone.
Would you say that you no longer get any pleasure or satisfaction from things you used to enjoy, even when you make yourself do them?

I’m not sure I’d say no pleasure at all. It’s more muted, I guess. Like if I make myself do something I used to like, sometimes it’s still okay, but it doesn’t really hit the same. I don’t think it’s completely gone.
Have you found that you don’t care about doing things you used to care about, like even small things that used to make you feel good, like finishing a task or spending time with someone close to you?

Yeah… I guess I have noticed that. Like at work, I used to joke around with the regulars more, and after shifts I’d text my brother or answer him pretty quick. Now I mostly just keep my face straight, say what I need to say, and let messages sit there. It’s not that I’m trying to be rude, I just don’t really feel the push to do it.

Have you found that things you used to really enjoy, like spending time with people close to you or doing certain activities, don’t bring you any pleasure or satisfaction anymore — even when you make yourself do them?

I don’t know that I’d say they bring me no pleasure at all. It’s more like… less than before. If I make myself do something or see someone, it can be fine, but I don’t really get much out of it the way I used to.
Would you say that you now get little or no pleasure from almost all activities that used to bring you joy, even when you make yourself do them?

I’m not sure I’d put it as almost all activities. Some things still feel okay if I actually do them. It’s just… the enjoyment is lower than it used to be, and I don’t always feel like bothering with it.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to care about, so much so that doing them feels like just going through the motions, even when you push yourself to do them?

I wouldn’t say completely lost interest, no. It’s more like I just don’t feel much pull toward things. Like with the regulars at work, I used to joke around more, and now I mostly keep a straight face and say what I have to. And with my brother, I’ll see his texts after a shift and just let them sit there. It feels like effort, even if I know I should answer.
Would you say that you now get little or no pleasure from most of the things you used to enjoy, even when you make yourself do them?

Yeah… I’d say it’s less pleasure, but not none. Like I used to joke around with the regulars at work, and now I mostly just keep my face straight and say what I need to say. After shifts, my brother will text me, and I’ll see it, but I just let it sit there because I don’t feel much pull to answer. It all just feels like more effort than it used to.
Would you say that you now get little or no pleasure from almost all of the things you used to enjoy, even when you make yourself do them?
I don’t think I’d say almost all, no. It’s more that things feel kind of muted. Some stuff can still be okay once I’m doing it, but I don’t get as much out of it as I used to.
Have you been feeling like you are worth less than others or that you deserve to be punished for things you've done, even if they weren't that bad?

Yeah. I keep feeling like I’ve let my family down, especially with taking on the mortgage. And when I mess up even a little at work, it feels like proof that I’m useless. Sometimes I think I deserve whatever happens because of it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining a noticeable amount without trying?

I haven’t really tracked my weight, so I’m not sure about a number. But my eating’s been pretty uneven. Some weeks I barely touch the staff meal, and then other nights I get home and just eat whatever’s in the kitchen to feel settled.
Have you ever felt so down that you've thought about hurting yourself or that life isn't worth living?

Yeah… sometimes. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But when I’m lying awake before an early shift, I’ll think it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up, so I wouldn’t have to keep failing at everything.
Have you ever felt so slowed down that even simple tasks felt almost impossible to get through, or had times where you couldn’t sit still because your body felt so restless?

Yeah, both, I guess. At work people have noticed I’ll pace around and keep checking the same tables or receipts over and over. Other times I feel really slowed down, like just grabbing menus or walking over to the POS takes me longer than it should. It’s frustrating because it’s simple stuff.
